title: Keyboard Mappings Issue with PowerToys in Cloud/Dev Boxes

status.label: Covered by the open Remote Desktop remapping tracker
status.detail: The same local-versus-remote Keyboard Manager conflict is tracked in open #21258; closed Dev Box report #30982 was explicitly closed as its duplicate.

judgment.rationale: #33932 reports that local Keyboard Manager settings interfere with mappings in a Cloud/Dev Box reached over Remote Desktop, and disabling Keyboard Manager on the local system restores the remote mappings. Open #21258 tracks Keyboard Manager remaps behaving incorrectly through Remote Desktop, including the same local-disable workaround. The more specific prior Dev Box report #30982 was explicitly closed as a duplicate of #21258. Keep this cloud/dev-box report attached to that active Remote Desktop tracker rather than splitting the same host-to-remote interaction into parallel work.
evidence: The #33932 reporter lists PowerToys 0.82.1 and says local Keyboard Manager settings prevent mappings from working in Cloud/Dev Boxes; disabling local Keyboard Manager restores them.
A commenter reports the issue on 0.85.1 and notes that replacing the local CapsLock-to-Ctrl remap with a registry Scancode Map allows remote Keyboard Manager shortcuts to work.
Open #21258 tracks Keyboard Manager key remappings malfunctioning through Windows Remote Desktop; one commenter reports that disabling local Keyboard Manager makes the remote setting work.
Closed issue #30982 describes a Dev Box accessed through Remote Desktop where restored local mappings do not work remotely; a maintainer closed it as a duplicate of #21258 on 2026-04-19.
Issue #21258 remains open with current activity and is the existing tracker for the remote remapping interaction.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue tracking the local/remote remapping conflict in #21258; do not create a competing fix or duplicate issue design for #33932.

fix_assessment.rationale: This report is covered by open Remote Desktop tracker #21258, and the more specific closed Dev Box report #30982 was explicitly marked as its duplicate; no competing fix should be created.

issue_context.summary: Local Keyboard Manager settings interfere with remappings in a Remote Desktop Cloud/Dev Box; this interaction is already tracked in #21258.

inferences: The reports likely share a host-versus-remote input interception interaction, but the exact behavior can vary with the local remapping and remote-session configuration.

Keep #33932 as an additional Cloud/Dev Box instance of that tracked interaction, not a separate design queue item.
